parsed_description: Make Our Home your home—at the intersection of Seattle’s storied past and vibrant future. From the doorstep of your exposed brick loft, relish a Puget Sound playground including Seattle’s transformed 20-acre Waterfront Park & Promenade, Habitat Beach, Main Street Plaza, Pioneer Square’s revitalized art and restaurant scene, and front row seats to World Cup soccer, playoff baseball and championship football. Through your wall of windows or the 300 +/- sq ft private terrace, take in expansive Elliott Bay, Great Wheel and Space Needle views. The interior features soaring 11-ft ceilings, exposed beams, hardwoods, steel wrapped stairs, high end appliances and illuminated built-in display niches. Originally built in 1892 as Our Home Hotel, a fully reinforced structure replaced the original in 1987 while preserving the charismatic brick facade. Today, this boutique building with its timeless appeal is one of the waterfront’s most sought after communities—a coveted home base, rare pied à terre or live-work loft opportunity with parking and storage included. Take a morning run or bike ride along the seawall to Myrtle Edwards Park, picnic among Buster Simpson art in the park, and savor the latest Molly Moons flavor at the historic Washington Street Boat Landing. There’s no place like home—Our Home—anywhere else in Seattle.

The basement is over 1,600 sq ft with 9-foot ceilings, currently used as a home gym with a sauna & bath and easily adapted for other uses. Multiple rooms open directly to the private, level yard with an outdoor kitchen, patio & low-maintenance grounds. A home of this caliber rarely comes available!

parsed_description: These are the landmark addresses, where those who buy, stay (44 years, in this case). But it's not just the address. You can feel a good house. One that knows how to shelter its people, hosting them with warmth and quiet solidity through all the seasons of their lives. Outside, this stately 1908 Tudor Revival sits squarely on its over-sized lot on one of Capitol Hill's finest legacy streets. Inside, surprises await.  Remarkably light and airy, the home has generous rooms, large windows and extensive, finely painted woodwork. At the front, original formal day rooms and a grand entry, with an elegant staircase rising to the 2nd floor mezzanine. To the rear, the home's casual side emerges, with a big, open kitchen/family room ringed with windows opening onto the private rear patio and gardens. Upstairs, find views of Lake Washington and the Cascades, large corner bedrooms, a vintage barrel-vaulted, fully tiled primary bath, skylit family lounge and several bonus spaces. The unfinished basement offers acres of dry storage, laundry and potential. An enormous 2-car garage with 11' ceilings, flooded with natural light, will easily accommodate vehicles, kayaks and projects. “Now this is the kind of house you want,” our pickiest inspector kept saying. Built solid, it was top-of-the-line when new, made to last, and well maintained ever since...with many quality updates along the way. It's a structure worthy of the investments that will take it another 120 years into the future.
